## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: For a fixture change-id, the ledger contains facts for resolved feature-flag...

The system SHALL ensure that for a fixture change-id, the ledger contains facts for resolved feature-flag values, the vendor/model/tier used, and the latest signal snapshot, each with full provenance.

#### Scenario: For a fixture change-id, the ledger contains facts for resolved feature-flag...

WHEN `extend-collect-facts-sources` is implemented
THEN For a fixture change-id, the ledger contains facts for resolved feature-flag values, the vendor/model/tier used, and the latest signal snapshot, each with full provenance.

### Requirement: Episodic memories are read from the existing closed-loop-learning store,...

The system SHALL ensure that episodic memories are read from the existing closed-loop-learning store, with no new store created.

#### Scenario: Episodic memories are read from the existing closed-loop-learning store,...

WHEN `extend-collect-facts-sources` is implemented
THEN Episodic memories are read from the existing closed-loop-learning store, with no new store created.

### Requirement: Disabling any one adapter yields a source_unavailable fact for it while the...

The system SHALL ensure that disabling any one adapter yields a source_unavailable fact for it while the other sources still populate.

#### Scenario: Disabling any one adapter yields a source_unavailable fact for it while the...

WHEN `extend-collect-facts-sources` is implemented
THEN Disabling any one adapter yields a source_unavailable fact for it while the other sources still populate.
